objects.scope: Independent arithmetic/coverage/causality oracles on actual product modules, fixed archives and bounded generated inputs; not a universal floating-point proof or predictive-validation certificate.

auditedFixes.boundary: An inferred daily gap crossing a year/month end must mark the prior observed period; explicit missingDates cannot double-count it. Exchange sessions require declared missing dates.
Calendar-month shifts preserve years 0000–0099 and reject results outside the accepted 0000–9999 date domain.
Stable median/slope/log-return/geometric-mean arithmetic retains representable answers; genuinely unrepresentable output metrics fail explicitly.

algebra: expense, issuance, principal/conversion and four-pool accounting identities
peak advance plus bear shortening equals trough advance
boundedExecution: three MSTR capital policies and BMNR target-interpolation paths
day-by-day independent reward sweep and instrument active-day sums
four deliberately corrupted treasury outputs rejected
one seeded detailed ensemble and one long-horizon illustrative path

treasuryOracleInputs.method: Independent reviewed terms, settlement-event allocation, active-day coupon integration, separate cash/principal/conversion sums, explicit daily reward sweeps and withdrawal queues. No production instrument or liquidity transition is used as an expected-value oracle.

objects.treasuryDailyUiPathVerification: Separate scripts/verify-treasury-paths.mjs; this checker does not claim to rerun its daily asset-path integration coverage.

calendarIdentity.identity: trough advance = peak advance + shortening of the projected peak-to-trough interval

limitations: Generated cases and deterministic fixtures cover finite domains, not all possible inputs.

Accounting conservation holds for reviewed model terms and assumed settlement/withdrawal policies; it does not establish actual exercise, network exit times, legal remedies, taxes or future financing access.
The bridge terminal price and external valuation curve are imposed conditions; numerical correctness does not prove market accuracy.
Daily close MDD excludes unobserved and intraday lows; stock outputs are split-adjusted price returns, not dividend-inclusive total returns.
Calendar identities are algebraic decompositions, not evidence that four-year cycles cause future prices.

objects.finiteBoundaryOracle: Exact binary64 rational arithmetic with BigInt. Each slope is <= MAX and strictly above the midpoint between MAX and its predecessor.
